evidence_boundary: old overwritten-first-READ task/result unchanged; new independent fourth-task diagnostic

offline_generator_costs_and_labels.scope: prospective variable-write-order two-key binding and live-value composition; no arbitrary-key/content-address generalization claim; old datasets/results immutable

test_long.information: TRAIN frequency labels and raw last4 tokens only; no oracle/semantics/parser

test_unseen.information: TRAIN frequency labels and raw last4 tokens only; no oracle/semantics/parser

resources.memory_scope: actual process/allocator counters; peak is cumulative and includes audits; no energy claim
resources.replay_storage_scope: 128 raw/provenance array slots plus separately reported metadata; dataset/evidence arrays are not training replay capacity
